feeds.title: Fabiia Blog
feeds.description: Fabiia was founded in 2006 by Interior designer, Shija Walia and her husband Dr. Jiten Walia, who both share a profound love for design, entrepreneurship, value creation, and innovation. As an accomplished interior designer and the Creative Director at Fabiia, Shija Walia brings a distinct perspective to the interior design landscape. Her deep passion for textiles, color, art, and the creation of human-centric spaces intricately shape her diverse body of work. Guided by her expertise, Fabiia undertakes each project with integrity and originality.
